description.fun: Tynamo was designed to look like the larva of an eel. One alone gives off only a trickle of electricity, so they move in schools, and a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning. It discharges electricity when in danger from an organ that generates it. Its name mixes 'tiny' with 'dynamo', and its Japanese name adds 'whitebait'. Yusuke Ohmura designed the whole line.
description.guide: Tynamo is an Electric-type Pokémon based on a larval eel. It is weak alone but powerful in groups. It evolves into Eelektrik, then Eelektross with a Thunder Stone.
description.tagline: A tiny eel larva that teams up to strike like lightning.

description.fun: Eelektrik has a big appetite: the moment it spots prey, it coils around it and shocks it with the round spots on its sides, which are really electricity-generating organs, and then it chomps. Its designer, Yusuke Ohmura, based it on a large eel he once caught in a river, aiming for the same 'strong but disgusting' feeling. Its toothy mouth also recalls a lamprey's.
description.guide: Eelektrik is the evolved form of Tynamo, an Electric-type eel Pokémon that paralyses prey with electricity from the round organs on its sides. It evolves into Eelektross with a Thunder Stone.
description.tagline: A hungry eel that coils, zaps and chomps.

description.fun: Eelektross crawls out of the ocean on its arms to hunt, latches onto prey with its sucker mouth, shocks it through its fangs and drags it back into the sea. It can walk on land using the fins on its underside despite having no proper legs. Its look draws on lampreys, and its way of moving through the air with its mouth open may even recall koinobori, Japan's carp-shaped Children's Day windsocks.
description.guide: Eelektross is the final form of Tynamo, an Electric-type eel Pokémon that grabs prey with its sucker mouth and shocks it with its fangs. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Eelektross.
description.tagline: A lamprey-mouthed eel that crawls ashore to hunt.

description.fun: Mega Evolution makes it generate ten times the electricity and coats its arms in electrified mucus shaped like two milky-white 'false Eelektrik', nicknamed Eeleftrik and Eerightrik. It discharges its power through them and floats above the ground. When Mega Evolution ends, the mucus melts away, though some people freeze it for beauty treatments.
